Great !!!!!
Sep 2026 • Couples
An absolutely unforgettable culinary experience!
I had the great pleasure of dining at the restaurant Le Four last week with friends, and we were totally won over by the entire experience. Upon our arrival, we were welcomed by a warm, smiling staff who were very attentive throughout the evening.
The setting is at once elegant, warm, and intimate, creating an ideal atmosphere for a romantic dinner or a convivial meal. As for the cuisine, it was a true fireworks display of flavors. The chef masters the art of marrying fresh, seasonal products with remarkable creativity. Special mention for the main course, a meat cooked to perfection with tasty sides, as well as for the homemade desserts that melt in your mouth. The wine list also offers some very fine selections to accompany each dish.
The value for money is completely justified given the finesse of the dishes and the generosity of the portions. Le Four is undoubtedly one of the best spots in the city. It is an establishment that I recommend with my eyes closed, and I am already looking forward to returning to discover the next season's menu!
